messages:
Priya: kicking off a 5% canary for release r2026.03.21 at 12:05 UTC. primary checks: p50/p95 latency, 502s, and embed quality. tagging ops for stop/go.
Marcos: ack. change window good for APAC but be mindful of EU traffic spike around 12:10.
Ben: noted. pin previous model v2026.03.17 as rollback target?
Priya: yes - pinning now. will also enable kv-cache prewarm.
deploybot: Deploy started for r2026.03.21 -> canary=5%
```
# deploy command
deploy --service=inference --image=r2026.03.21 --rollout=5% --pin-rollback=v2026.03.17
```
telemetry-bot: telemetry snapshot at 12:07 UTC: requests=12k, p95 latency +8% vs baseline, 502s=0.2% (baseline 0.05%). contextual note: small tail but trending.
Alice: seeing a tiny cluster of 502s from eu-west-1, +0.15% at node pool a. can we pause until we know origin?
Marcos: i'd vote pause. if kv-cache warms it'll help but don't want to ramp if backend failing.
Priya: pausing rollout. hold at 5%. pin confirmed.
deploybot: Rollout paused by Priya (user) at 12:09 UTC. current traffic stay on 5%.
Ben: quick diagnostic: running `kubectl logs -lapp=inference -n eu-west-1 | grep "502" | tail -n 5` shows upstream timeout spikes, correlating with cache-miss storms.
Alice: suggests increase cache TTL for canary route and throttle upstream retries for canary subset.
Priya: agree. Ops, can you adjust TTL + reduce retry multiplier for canary?
Marcos: applying changes to canary routing: setting KV_CACHE_TTL=120 and RETRY_MULTIPLIER=0.5 for r2026.03.21 canary.
ops-bot: config update applied to canary: KV_CACHE_TTL=120, RETRY_MULTIPLIER=0.5 (eu-west-1).
telemetry-bot: monitoring... next snapshot in 60s.
telemetry-bot: telemetry snapshot at 12:10:40 UTC: p95 latency back to +2% vs baseline, 502s down to 0.06%.
Marcos: looks stable. any objections to resuming ramp to 20%?
Ben: +1 from infra after the config change. watch the embedding drift job (evals) for the next hour.
Alice: +1 but keep pinned rollback ready for immediate rollback if regression in embed quality.
Priya: resuming to 20% now. will keep canary pinned and monitor release-evals.
deploybot: Rollout progressing: 5% -> 20% (initiated by Priya)
Priya: quick note for release notes: mention config throttle and kv-cache tweak as mitigation.
Marcos: ops confirm we have a hot path for rollback with the pinned v2026.03.17 image and a runbook ready.
ops-bot: rollback runbook verified. one-click rollback flag: `--force-rollback v2026.03.17` tested.
telemetry-bot: telemetry snapshot at 12:18 UTC: embed-quality checks passing sample prompts (A/B drift within tolerance).
Priya: final call — all clear to continue progressive rollout?
Alice: go for it from QA side.
Ben: go from infra. :thumbsup:
Marcos: go from oncall.
Priya: thanks team — proceeding to 100% per rollout policy. will keep the pin until 24h stable. :rocket:
deploybot: Rollout complete: r2026.03.21 -> 100% at 12:27 UTC. pinned rollback target v2026.03.17 remains available.
__meta_note: This thread is a staged rollout coordination/stop-go call: short, operational messages with a deploybot and telemetry snapshots.
